stem.text: Which pair of forces forms a couple with a torque of $30\,\text{N m}$?

A.alt: Two equal and opposite parallel forces of 30 N, one above the other, separated by a vertical double arrow labelled 2.0 m.

B.alt: A 40 N force along a horizontal line and a 10 N force below it, separated by a vertical double arrow labelled 1.0 m.

C.alt: A 25 N force along a horizontal line and a 5 N force below and to the left, separated by a vertical double arrow labelled 1.0 m.

D.alt: Two 15 N parallel forces, one above the other, separated by a vertical double arrow labelled 2.0 m.
